description: Defines data structures, enums, and classes for parsing and managing DNS hosts files, including functions for parsing hosts file contents and a class for reading hosts from a file.

classes.name: DnsHostsParser
classes.description: Abstract class for parsing DNS hosts data.

classes.name: DnsHostsFileParser
classes.description: Implementation of DnsHostsParser that reads hosts data from a specified file.

methods.name: ParseHostsWithCommaModeForTesting
methods.description: Parses hosts file contents with a specified comma mode, primarily for testing.

methods.name: ParseHosts
methods.description: Parses hosts file contents and stores results in a DnsHosts map.
